name: The Sisterhood of Elune

angles.text: As a night elf, answering the Sisterhood of Elune's summons is a sacred duty tied to your people's spiritual life and leadership.
As a priest, your devotion to Elune links you to the old traditions of the kaldorei temple. Answering Sister Aquinne's call follows those traditions.
As an Alliance traveler in Kalimdor, helping the Sisterhood supports night elf spiritual and civic leadership in Darnassus.

faq.answer: Sister Aquinne is a priestess and emissary of the Sisterhood of Elune in Darnassus. She receives travelers who come to help with urgent matters facing the night elves.

aliases: who are the sisters of elune
faq.answer: The Sisterhood of Elune is an ancient order of night elf priestesses devoted to Elune, the moon goddess. Its members guide and heal their people, lead kaldorei culture, and oversee their spiritual welfare and defense.
faq.q: What is the Sisterhood of Elune?

aliases: where to turn in sisterhood of elune
where do i go for sisterhood of elune
faq.answer: Travel to Darnassus, the night elf capital atop Teldrassil. Sister Aquinne awaits you there with word from the Sisterhood.
faq.q: Where do I need to go to complete this quest?

aliases: why does the sisterhood need help
faq.answer: Sister Aquinne says the Sisterhood needs prompt help with pressing troubles in Darnassus and the surrounding night elf lands. Speak with her to learn what duties await.
faq.q: Why does the Sisterhood require aid?

aliases: can horde do sisterhood of elune
faq.answer: No. The Sisterhood of Elune is part of night elf leadership and aligned with the Alliance. Darnassus is an Alliance capital, so only Alliance adventurers can answer this call.
faq.q: Can Horde characters undertake this quest?

aliases: who leads the sisterhood of elune
faq.answer: High Priestess Tyrande Whisperwind leads the Sisterhood of Elune and the kaldorei nation. She guides her sisters from the Temple of the Moon in Darnassus.
faq.q: Who leads the Sisterhood of Elune?

sections.body: You are sent to Darnassus to meet Sister Aquinne. When urgent matters threaten their people and sacred lands, the priestesses of Elune call on trusted champions for aid.
sections.title: A Call to the Capital

sections.body: Sister Aquinne welcomes you in Darnassus, relieved by your prompt arrival. The priestesses face growing demands, so they seek help beyond their cloistered ranks.
sections.title: Reporting to Sister Aquinne

summary: In Darnassus, the Sisterhood of Elune needs help with urgent troubles in night elf lands. Sister Aquinne receives those who come to aid the priestesses.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Sisterhood of Elune
